implementation: Automatic CUDA context routing and universal prefix cache reuse

modes.gpu_tiled: KV in GPU VRAM, blockwise attention, CPU RAM hidden/head preparation
modes.cpu_streamed: KV in CPU RAM, bounded pinned transfer buffers, CPU RAM head preparation

hardware_scope: Physical tests: RTX 3070 Ti and RTX 3090, Flash and Full; hardware-policy checks: supported SM75+ Turing/Ampere/Ada/Hopper/Blackwell. Unavailable families are not physically benchmarked.
cache_rules: Longest exact prefix, same model/media/pooling identity; total context controls routing even on warm hits.
Recurrent state independently cloned; CPU prefix KV borrowed immutable and only suffix storage allocated.
Final CPU-stream checkpoints adopt append-only CPU KV/hidden storage without duplicating full context.
Allocated-but-unpublished snapshot bytes credited once to RAM admission.
RAM pressure evicts unrelated LFU snapshots, protects the matched prefix; GPU eviction spills to RAM.
No unrelated-prefix blending, truncation, activation quantization or multiple GPUs per service.
limits: Estimated memory budgets and observed peaks, not allocation reservations or maximum-accuracy guarantees.
Full still requires enough GPU VRAM for its weights and BF16; package minimum is SM75, not every historical NVIDIA card.
Streaming/tiled requests use one worker; small compatible requests retain batching. No continuous interleaving of long streamed jobs yet.
ROCm keeps its existing separate policy; native compiled-kernel startup probe can disable tiled/stream paths on unsupported runtimes.
